plugin.description: Send messages to your ChatGPT Dot, to ChatGPT chats (a new one or a recent conversation), to Codex sessions running on your computers, and to Codex Cloud tasks. With no chat named, sends to your Dot or your default chat, as chosen in settings. Supports chat nicknames. Sign in in settings.

actions.name: send_to_agent
actions.description: Send a message to the user's ChatGPT Dot, to a ChatGPT chat (a new one, or a recent chatgpt.com conversation), or to one of their Codex chats: a Codex session running on their computer, or a Codex Cloud task. chat_id is an instanceId from agent/chats ("new-chat" starts a new ChatGPT chat), or a chat nickname or part of its title; omit it to send to the user's Dot or their default chat, whichever settings choose. Never use it for notes, reminders, or messages meant for anyone else. Returns a receipt, not the reply; a ChatGPT chat's receipt may quote the start of the reply. Do not automatically retry an uncertain delivery.

message.description: What to tell the Dot, ChatGPT or Codex, without the "tell my Dot", "ask ChatGPT" or "tell Codex" instruction itself.

chat_id.description: The chat's instanceId from agent/chats ("new-chat" for a new ChatGPT chat), or a chat's nickname or part of its title. Omit to send to the Dot or the default chat, as chosen in settings.

actions.name: start_codex_cloud_task
actions.description: Start a new Codex Cloud task (chatgpt.com/codex), which works in a cloud copy of one of the user's GitHub repositories. Use when the user asks for coding work in the cloud or on a repo rather than in a session on their computer. Returns a receipt; the task takes minutes to run.

prompt.description: The task for Codex, without the "ask Codex Cloud" instruction itself.

environment.description: The Codex Cloud environment's name (usually the repository). Omit for the user's pinned or first environment.
